metadata.description: You are the Zap. You're a kid with electric-zapping superpowers and one glittery bath-bomb problem. After losing your zap in a fizz-filled disaster, it’s up to YOU to get it back. Sneak into secret labs, team up with wild sidekicks, and chase down the truth. Every choice leads to a new twist! 26 different endings in total! Fast-paced, funny, and totally powered by you, this adventure puts you in control of the chaos. A superpowered Pick-Your-Path interactive story.
